Simultaneously, equilibrate the solution with a fixed-pressure gas phase containing 5 atmospheres of Hydrogen Sulfide (H2​S).

At reaction step 100, how many moles of H2S gas has dissolved into solution?

A. 3.041e-02
B. 3.044e-02
C. 3.042e-02
D. 3.040e-02

Use tools as needed for PHREEQC / quantitative work.
